info.name: Grubhub Deliveries Delivery Status Schedules API

params.name: merchant_id
params.description: The unique identifier for the merchant on Grubhub.

items.docs: Returns the full weekly delivery hours for a merchant. The schedule defines the hours per day of the week that the merchant can accept delivery orders.

params.name: merchant_id
params.description: The unique identifier for the merchant on Grubhub.

items.docs: Creates or updates the weekly delivery schedule for a merchant, specifying the hours per day of the week that the merchant can accept delivery orders. If a schedule does not exist, one will be created.
